+# Mini Template
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript template renderer for Bun.
+
+## Use
+
+```ts
+import { render } from "./src/engine.ts";
+
+render("Hello, {{user.name}}!", { user: { name: "Ada" } });
+```
+
+Interpolations escape HTML by default; use `{{{path}}}` for unescaped output. The
+language also supports comments, `if`/`else`, and array-only `each` blocks:
+
+```handlebars
+{{#each items}}{{@index}}: {{this}}; {{else}}No items{{/each}}
+```
+
+Within an `each` block, `this` is the item and `@index` is its zero-based index.
+Named paths first resolve against an object item, then fall back to the root data.
+
+## CLI
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts TEMPLATE_FILE DATA.json
+```
+
+Rendered text is written to stdout. Errors are written to stderr with a non-zero
+exit code.
+
+## Tests
+
+```sh
+bun test
+```
